{"BypassSandbox":true,"CommandLine":"python -c "
import pandas as pd, json
df = pd.read_csv(r'C:\Users\Pavan\hackerrank-orchestrate-october26\dataset\sample_output.csv')
evidence_csv = pd.read_csv(r'C:\Users\Pavan\hackerrank-orchestrate-october26\dataset\evidence_files.csv')
ev_map = dict(zip(evidence_csv['file_id'], evidence_csv['file_path']))

items = []
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    steps = json.loads(row['steps_json'])
    for s in steps:
        ev_id = s.get('evidence_id')
        ev_path = ev_map.get(ev_id, '')
        items.append((s.get('phase'), s.get('system_id'), s.get('resource_id'), s.get('operation'), s.get('state'), ev_id, ev_path))

for item in items[:25]:
    print(item)
